name: The Bitcoin Bull
description:
Jason 'GoingParabolic' Williams (282K followers, self-described 'Core Lord') announced he bought 70% of a token's supply and asked his audience what he should do next: either a supply control thesis test in real time or a chaotic crowdsourced experiment on Crypto Twitter.
Jason is an accomplished executive, board member and investor with over 15 years demonstrated success leading companies through start-up, change, accelerated growth and successful exits. Recognized as a disruptive innovator and dynamic leader, Jason builds sound organizations from the ground level by substantiating unique value propositions and creating a competitive edge in large mature industries.

As a hands-on leader, Jason personally raised capital and carried organizations to exit; generating over a half billion dollars in value for shareholders. Jason leads and motivates companies with a customer-first mentality; where metrics and customers’ success truly matter. Jason has in-depth knowledge of health care, pharmaceutical, medical device, energy and retail industries. He also has a number of patents pending and issued revolving around energy and robotics.
